title: add nvtx ranges, runtime counters, and microbench harness + perf dashboard
author: Priya Shah
description: This PR adds targeted runtime instrumentation and a small microbenchmark harness to help quantify recent optimizations to kernels, scheduling, KV cache usage, and continuous batching. Motivation: we lack fine-grained latency attribution for the new continuous-batching path and KV cache interactions; this makes regression debugging and kernel selection heuristics difficult. Changes included: 1) NVTX ranges around hot-path stages (request dequeue, batching window, kernel launch, kv-cache lookup, kv-cache update, output merge) with readable names and optional payloads; NVTX is gated by BUILD_NVTX to avoid runtime deps. 2) New atomic counters exposed via /metrics (prometheus) for kv_cache.{hits,misses,evictions}, batching.{requests_queued,batched_in_window,window_misses}, and runtime_kernels.{cpu_time_ns,gpu_time_ns} aggregated per-model-family. 3) A lightweight C++ microbench harness (runtime/microbench) with three scenarios: pure-kernel (synthetic sequences), kv-cache-hit-path, continuous-batch end-to-end latency under configurable QPS; harness outputs JSON summaries for CI. 4) A Grafana dashboard JSON and ingestion script under tools/perf-dashboard to visualize NVTX-correlated histograms (via tracing bridge) and the new counters; added example panels for KV hit-rate and batching latency percentiles. 5) CI perf workflow that runs the microbench on a small GPU runner and posts JSON artifacts, with a gating check that fails only on large regressions (>10% p99). 6) Docs and README for instrumentation and how to add new ranges/counters. Checklist: - [x] NVTX ranges added and gated behind BUILD_NVTX - [x] Prom counter metrics implemented and registered - [x] Microbench harness + example configs - [x] Grafana dashboard + ingestion script - [x] CI perf job added and validated on PRs - [x] Documentation and examples. Rationale: NVTX ranges let us correlate host-side latency with GPU kernels in Nsight and trace collectors; counters provide long-term SLO metrics and alerting signals; microbench harness gives reproducible numbers for PRs and rollouts. Follow-ups: wire counters into redwood-console alerts (ENG-7189), add per-shard tagging for Dedicated (ENG-7214), and extend microbench to cover quantized kernels. See commits for small, targeted diffs and code comments describing measurement semantics.

review_conversation: Ethan Miller (reviewer): Can we gate NVTX with a build flag so we don't pull in libnvtools unless requested? Observability teams will use it but infra may not want the dep.
Priya Shah (author): Yes - added BUILD_NVTX toggle; default is off. Updated docs to show how to enable in private deployments.
Alyssa Chen (reviewer): The counters look good; please ensure kv_cache counters are emitted with model and shard labels to avoid aggregate masking.
Priya Shah (author): Counters include a model_family label; per-shard tagging is tracked in ENG-7214 as a follow-up to avoid extra label cardinality in hosted tier.
Wei Zhang (reviewer): microbench output is great. Can CI run a baseline and fail the PR if p99 regresses more than 10%?
Priya Shah (author): Implemented a perf gating script that compares to a stored baseline artifact. For this PR the baseline is recorded in ci/artifacts/baselines/runtime_perf_202508.json.
Ethan Miller (reviewer): Minor nit: NVTX range names should be consistent with tracing spans. Fixed in follow-up commit.
Alyssa Chen (approver): approved after small doc fixes and adding a note about the metric cardinality tradeoff.
perf_summary: Microbench results on a p4d-small runner (single-model synthetic): continuous-batch p50: 12.8ms (baseline 13.5ms, -5.2%), p95: 22.3ms (baseline 24.8ms, -10.1%), p99: 31.7ms (baseline 35.8ms, -11.5%). KV-cache hit-path shows 0.6ms median for cached tokens. Numbers are reproducible within 3% STD across 10 runs.
release_notes:
- Added NVTX ranges for host-to-GPU tracing
- Added Prometheus counters for KV cache and batching metrics
- Added a microbench harness and CI perf gating
- Added Grafana runtime dashboard for latency attribution
notes: This PR intentionally keeps NVTX and counters light-weight. The microbench is not for scale validation but for regression detection and kernel-level delta measurements. We avoided adding labels with high cardinality; shard-level tagging will be a configurable opt-in.
